summary: KB Editor 6 Fixes - All features verified. 1) New page creation via section '+' works - nav_group_key/section_key pre-filled via pendingNewForm ref. 2) New page creation via group '+' works. 3) Save button works for new pages - URL changes from /new to /slug. 4) New pages appear in sidebar under correct section. 5) Settings slider positioned correctly: z-20 (behind sidebar z-30), top:56px, left:256px, min-width:400px, width:400px, transition-transform duration-200. 6) Backdrop only covers content area (left:256px, top:56px). 7) Draft tag uses grey styling (bg-slate-500/20 text-slate-400) with mr-1.5 and group-hover/art:hidden. 8) Settings gear has mr-1 and group-hover/art:block.

issues: Console warning: 'flushSync was called from inside a lifecycle method' - React warning from TipTap editor, not blocking functionality
